description: This file defines enumeration-related functionality for SMS message statuses within the Fineract infrastructure. It provides methods to obtain status representations as EnumOptionData objects based on status IDs or specific SmsMessageStatusType values.

classes.name: SmsMessageEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to convert SMS message status types to EnumOptionData representations.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData object representing the SMS message status for a given status ID.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData object representing the SMS message status for a given SmsMessageStatusType value.
